brand.name: htmx
brand.what_they_do: htmx gives HTML direct access to AJAX, CSS transitions, WebSockets and server-sent events through attributes, so developers can build modern interfaces with hypertext.
brand.audience: Web developers who want interactive interfaces without a heavy JavaScript framework.
brand.tone: Plainspoken, playful and technical; short declarative sentences with a light joke.

type_pairing.heading: Bungee
type_pairing.why: Bungee's chunky display letters carry the retro, playful register; Space Mono's monospace body suits a web-tool brand that talks about HTML.

voice: Plainspoken and confident: it states what the tool does without hype.
Playful with the reader: it jokes lightly and invites tinkering.
Technical but warm: it explains hypertext simply and treats the developer as a peer.
do: Use the primary blue for headings and the cream background for large areas.
Use the orange-red accent sparingly, for links and highlights.
Keep the wordmark on a plain cream or white background with clear space around it.
Set headlines in Bungee and body text in Space Mono.
dont: Don't stretch, rotate or recolor the logos outside this palette.
Don't put the wordmark over busy photos or other logos.
Don't use more than two accent colors on one screen.
Don't use Space Mono for long body copy.
